metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by willard-pro — ticket automation pipelines and development tooling

plugins.name: ticket-auto-pipeline
plugins.description: Fully autonomous Linear ticket pipeline — appraise, implement, verify, and merge with zero user input. Bundles 20+ skills, state machine config, pipeline safety gates, and retrospective analysis.

plugins.name: knowledge-curator
plugins.description: Durable cross-project knowledge tracking — capture ideas, decisions, lessons, and discoveries with low friction, automatic resurfacing, and a dispatchable work stack.

plugins.name: fleet-controller
plugins.description: Parent orchestrator above ticket-planner and ticket-auto — dispatches planned tickets from initiative epics, monitors all active pipeline health via 11 detection engines, and aggregates execution feedback back to the planner. Bash-only, zero Claude agents.
